title_en: Supplementary Provisions (VIII) of the Supreme People's Court and the Supreme People's Procuratorate on the Execution of the Determination of Charges in the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China

articles.content_en:
January 30, 2024
Supreme People's Court Supreme People's Procuratorate
Supplementary Provisions on the Determination of Crimes for the Enforcement of the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China (VIII)
Fa Shi [2024] No. 3
Pursuant to the Amendment (XII) to the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China (hereinafter referred to as the Amendment (XII) to the Criminal Law), the Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on the Determination of Crimes for the Enforcement of the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China and the Opinions of the Supreme People's Procuratorate on the Determination of Crimes for the Application of the Specific Provisions of the Criminal Law are hereby amended as follows:
The crime name under Article 169 of the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China (Article 3 of the Amendment (XII) to the Criminal Law) is amended from "Crime of Engaging in Malpractices by Converting State-owned Assets at Low Prices into Shares or Selling Them" to "Crime of Engaging in Malpractices by Converting Company or Enterprise Assets at Low Prices into Shares or Selling Them."
These Provisions shall come into force as of March 1, 2024.
